name: Esumi Mei
source: A sports instructor. As regular customer at the bar that the protagonist, a man she seduces immediately when they first met, worked part-time at. She acts like an elder sister that enjoys teasing the protagonist. Mei was the ringleader that introduced the dormitory Kissuisou to the protagonist. She has taking a liking to the protagonist, so she acts kind to him all the time.
